name: clothing-extraction
description: Extract garments from photos as faithful white-background flat-lay product images.

interface.shortDescription: Turn clothing photos into faithful white-background flat lays.
interface.longDescription: Extract one garment from a model or cluttered photo, remove the person and background, reconstruct occluded areas conservatively, and generate a faithful white-background e-commerce flat-lay image.
defaultPrompt: 按 $clothing-extraction 执行，提取这件衣服。
用 $clothing-extraction 把模特上衣转成白底平铺商品图。
用 $clothing-extraction 分别提取整套穿搭中的每件单品。
